title: Insurance distribution: demands and needs, advice and product information
summary: What an insurance distributor records to show, later, what the customer needed, what was proposed and why, and what information the customer received before the contract.

articles.asks: Before a contract is concluded, specify the customer's demands and needs on the basis of information obtained from the customer, and give objective information about the product in a comprehensible form.
Any contract proposed must be consistent with the customer's insurance demands and needs.
Where advice is given before a specific contract is concluded, give the customer a personalised recommendation explaining why a particular product would best meet their demands and needs.
For non-life products, give the product information by way of the standardised insurance product information document (IPID).
How information reaches the customer: on paper, or on another durable medium or a website where the conditions for that are met.

Insurance undertakings, and intermediaries that manufacture insurance products, maintain, operate and review a process for the approval of each insurance product, or significant adaptation of an existing one, before it is marketed or distributed to customers.

kinds.title: Demands and needs
kinds.when: Once the customer's demands and needs are specified, before any contract is concluded.

fields.name: customer_ref
fields.description: Your own reference for the customer. Never a name.

fields.name: product_class
fields.description: The class of cover discussed, in your own terms, such as motor or home.

fields.name: information_obtained
fields.description: What the customer told you, and how you obtained it.

fields.name: demands_and_needs
fields.description: The demands and needs you specified from that information.

fields.name: proposed_product_ref
fields.description: Your reference for the product you proposed, if any.

fields.name: consistency_note
fields.description: Why the proposed contract is consistent with those demands and needs.

fields.name: advice_given
fields.description: Whether you gave advice. If true, an idd.recommendation record follows.

fields.name: adviser_ref
fields.description: Your reference for the person who handled the customer. Never a name.

fields.name: specified_at
fields.description: When the demands and needs were specified, UTC.

example.information_obtained: Interview at the office. Commutes 30 km a day by e-bike, stores it in a shared garage, has no other cover for theft.
example.demands_and_needs: Theft cover for the e-bike including the battery, and roadside assistance for breakdowns on the commute.
example.consistency_note: Covers theft of bike and battery from a shared garage and includes roadside assistance.

kinds.title: Personalised recommendation
kinds.when: When advice is given, once the recommendation is handed to the customer.

fields.name: customer_ref
fields.description: Your own reference for the customer. Never a name.

fields.name: demands_needs_record_id
fields.description: The record_id of the idd.demands-needs record this recommendation answers.

fields.name: recommended_product_ref
fields.description: Your reference for the product recommended.

fields.name: reasons
fields.description: Why this product would best meet the customer's demands and needs.

fields.name: document_digest
fields.description: SHA-256 of the recommendation document exactly as the customer received it.

fields.name: medium
fields.description: How the recommendation reached the customer.

fields.name: given_at
fields.description: When the recommendation was given, UTC.

example.reasons: The only product in our range that covers battery theft from a shared garage; roadside assistance is included rather than an extra.

kinds.title: Product information document handed over
kinds.when: For a non-life product, when the IPID is given to the customer.

fields.name: customer_ref
fields.description: Your own reference for the customer. Never a name.

fields.name: product_ref
fields.description: Your reference for the product.

fields.name: ipid_version
fields.description: The version of the IPID, as the manufacturer labels it.

fields.name: ipid_digest
fields.description: SHA-256 of the IPID file exactly as handed over.

fields.name: medium
fields.description: How the IPID reached the customer.

fields.name: provided_at
fields.description: When it was provided, UTC.

kinds.title: Pre-contract information provided
kinds.when: When the pre-contract documents reach the customer: each is sealed by its digest, and the customer can be given the receipt too, so both sides hold the same evidence of what was provided.

fields.name: customer_ref
fields.description: Your reference for the customer, never a name.

fields.name: contract_ref
fields.description: Your reference for the proposed contract.

fields.name: documents
fields.description: SHA-256 of each document provided, exactly as provided (the IPID, the terms, the demands-and-needs statement).

fields.name: medium
fields.description: How the documents were provided.

fields.name: provided_at
fields.description: When they were provided, UTC.

fields.name: product_version_record_id
fields.description: The record_id of the idd.product-version in force.

kinds.title: Product version approved
kinds.when: Each time a product, or a significant adaptation of it, is approved: its terms and target market are sealed by their digests, so which terms applied on a given day can be shown.

fields.name: product_ref
fields.description: Your reference for the product.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Your version label.

fields.name: terms_digest
fields.description: SHA-256 of the terms and conditions exactly as approved.

fields.name: target_market_digest
fields.description: SHA-256 of the target market definition as approved.

fields.name: approved_at
fields.description: When the product version was approved, UTC.

fields.name: effective_from
fields.description: From when it may be distributed.

retention: This pack does not state how long to keep these records. Check the period that applies to you with your supervisor or your professional federation. In Belgium the directive is transposed by the Act of 4 April 2014 on insurance, and the FSMA supervises its conduct rules.
notes: The Worker's own quote ledger (v1) can record what was proposed and priced; this pack covers what stays with you.
